target.title: feat(dashboard): add unlisted OpenClaw Bay demo
target.body:
## Summary

- add an unlisted, read-only OpenClaw Bay demo at `/bay-demo`
- turn the existing ClawSweeper status snapshot into an animated beach with live stage lanes, terminal pools, retrigger tunnels, repository filters, search, a detail drawer, master-sweeper modes, and a bounded 20-outcome tide
- poll the shared Worker status 25% less often than Overview (every 20 seconds versus every 15 seconds), without adding a new GitHub API query path; actual upstream GitHub refreshes remain cache-dependent
- keep `/bay` unpublished and leave the existing Overview, issue-triage, and PR-proof-triage navigation unchanged

![OpenClaw Bay deterministic Playwright proof](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brokemac79/clawsweeper/92f4ecceddabdcd4b72aae1cab5de64b280d7761/docs/proof/openclaw-bay/playwright-proof-storyboard.jpg)

[Inspect the compact Playwright trace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brokemac79/clawsweeper/92f4ecceddabdcd4b72aae1cab5de64b280d7761/docs/proof/openclaw-bay/trace.zip) · [read the 19-assertion summary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brokemac79/clawsweeper/92f4ecceddabdcd4b72aae1cab5de64b280d7761/docs/proof/openclaw-bay/proof-summary.json) · [inspect the runner and exact fixtures](https://github.com/brokemac79/clawsweeper/tree/92f4ecceddabdcd4b72aae1cab5de64b280d7761/docs/proof/openclaw-bay) · [watch the 32-second live browser recording](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brokemac79/clawsweeper/92f4ecceddabdcd4b72aae1cab5de64b280d7761/docs/openclaw-bay-demo.mp4)

## Problem

The operational Overview is intentionally dense and table-oriented. Maintainers asked to try a more visual, playful way to see whether ClawSweeper is active without replacing the existing operational surfaces. This PR publishes the selected prototype as an explicitly experimental demo on the existing dashboard Worker.

## Implementation

- renders active work in Arriving, Setting up, Reviewing, Repairing, and Applying lanes using the existing worker snapshot
- raises a READY flag and lets the master sweeper animate proved forward movement
- treats any new `run_id` for the same GitHub item as a retrigger, using the tunnel/re-emergence path even when a poll first sees the new run in the same or a later lane
- shows Completed, Failed, and Cancelled only from explicit terminal evidence; disappearing workers stay CHECKING during the bounded confirmation grace period
- stores only a bounded terminal view: fewer than 20 current outcomes, the latest 20 washed outcomes retained for the 60-second wash animation, and at most 256 seen event IDs under the existing seven-day status TTL
- adds `Where's my crustacean?`, repository filters, GitHub/workflow detail links, patrol/on-change modes, local-only tide preview, reduced-motion handling, and hardened noindex/no-store/frame-blocked headers

## GitHub API And Runtime Load

Bay is a presentation over the existing cache-backed `/api/status` snapshot. It adds **no browser-to-GitHub requests and no new GitHub REST or GraphQL query path**. Terminal outcomes and timing samples are derived from workflow-job and recent-close data already collected for Overview.

Bay polls the Worker every 20 seconds versus Overview every 15 seconds: three rather than four status requests per minute after initial load, or 25% fewer browser-to-Worker requests. This is deliberately **not** described as 25% fewer upstream GitHub API calls: cache expiry, edge location, and concurrent viewers determine whether either status request causes a refresh. The defensible GitHub API claim is neutral/no-new-query-path, while browser polling load is lower.

## Validation

- hosted CI on exact head `92f4ecceddabdcd4b72aae1cab5de64b280d7761` — `pnpm check`, Windows Codex launcher, both CodeQL analyses, and aggregate CodeQL passed
- `node --test test/dashboard-smoke.test.ts test/dashboard-worker.test.ts` — 80/80 passed after the final accepted proof-harness fixes
- `pnpm run build:dashboard` — passed
- `pnpm run lint:dashboard` — passed
- `pnpm run lint:scripts` — passed
- `pnpm run dashboard:smoke -- http://127.0.0.1:8793` — passed; verified `/bay-demo`, `/bay` remains 404, security headers, shared status schema, zero direct GitHub requests, and all three WebP assets
- `node --check docs/proof/openclaw-bay/run-proof.mjs` — passed
- `bash -n docs/proof/openclaw-bay/run-proof.sh` — passed
- `pnpm exec oxlint docs/proof/openclaw-bay/run-proof.mjs --deny-warnings -D correctness` — passed
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` — passed

## Deterministic Browser Proof

The checked-in runner starts the real local Wrangler `/bay-demo` route and loads the real artwork. It replaces only `/api/status` with three exact synthetic, redacted responses so the interactions are repeatable without credentials, live dashboard payloads, or GitHub API traffic.

Crabbox `local-container` proof `cbx_1415645b8c3c` (`crimson-prawn`) used `mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.60.0-noble` and passed all 19 assertions:

- crustacean and master-sweeper animation clocks advance
- a forward transition raises READY, is physically swept, and lands in the reported lane
- a changed run ID creates both retrigger tunnel openings with the exact burrow label, then resurfaces in Setting up
- search focuses and highlights GitHub reference `#97722`
- repository filtering leaves only the selected repository's active and terminal items
- the detail drawer exposes exactly the safe GitHub item, job, and workflow-run links
- tide preview visibly animates, performs no mutation request, and leaves terminal keys and `3 / 20` unchanged
- visible diagnostics show the synthetic redacted state and final network boundary
- zero browser console errors, uncaught page errors, browser-to-`api.github.com` requests, or non-GET/HEAD requests

The trace's three JSON response bodies match the checked-in fixture SHA-256 values. A binary scan found no tokens, authorization headers, cookies, local Windows user paths, usernames, or live/private payloads. The proof was generated against implementation commit `29e4329647e06bfe83971506962602aab211323f`; head `92f4ecceddabdcd4b72aae1cab5de64b280d7761` adds only the reproducible runner, fixtures, trace, storyboard, summary, and documentation.

## Review Closeout

- `codex review --uncommitted` — final dirty-patch review clean after actioning two proof-only findings: check in the runner/exact fixtures, and require both visible tunnel openings plus the exact burrow label before recording PASS
- focused proof rerun after each accepted finding — 19/19 Playwright assertions, 80/80 dashboard tests, syntax/lint, trace-to-fixture hash comparison, and privacy scan all passed
- `codex review --base origin/main` — final four-commit branch review clean; no actionable correctness issues, with dashboard build and targeted tests passing
- independent public-boundary audit — clean: route remains public-but-unlisted, read-only, noindexed, frame-blocked, escaped, and free of direct GitHub/mutation paths

## Maintainer Decision Requested

Technical proof is now supplied, but this remains a product-boundary decision: should the production dashboard publish `/bay-demo` as an unlisted/noindexed yet unauthenticated public-by-URL experiment, with terminal/tide state intentionally bounded to a live 20-outcome presentation rather than a history or audit ledger? `/bay` and the normal dashboard navigation remain unpublished.

## Risks And Rollout

- `/bay-demo` is unlisted, not private. Anyone who knows or guesses the URL can open it; a maintainer-only rollout would need Cloudflare Access or separate application authentication.
- this is an experimental view, not a replacement for operational triage pages
- the terminal feed is intentionally bounded and evidence-based, so it is not a historical ledger
- inline page CSS/JS is allowed by the current route-specific CSP; external files or CSP nonces would be a later hardening improvement if the demo becomes permanent

## Release Note

Experimental: add an unlisted OpenClaw Bay dashboard demo that visualises the existing ClawSweeper worker state as an animated shoreline.
